bbd.text: Baishya, a young whisperer, leads her twin Naiva up a sacred mountain, insisting that her vision has led them there, until an avalanche buries them on the Eternal Ice snowfield.
Her hands glow green and she shapes the snow into a wall that holds, and when windfolk emerge she faints trying to hear them, then explains that they called her up to give a message for Grandmother.
After the twins find the hunting party alive, Baishya addresses her grandmother as Yasova Dragonclaw, a name Atarka has banned, and slips into a whisper trance.
She then explains that the vision came from Ugin and that they must go to his grave.

m19.text: In Core Set 2019, Baishya rolls a boulder to block a broodling's ice breath and admits she did not know she could move a rock like that.
At Ugin's grave, Yasova tells the twins they must become guardians of the carved memories of the ancestors, and Baishya hears the whisperers' headpieces whisper to her.
Saying that Ugin is calling her, she slips through a narrow cleft, and Naiva follows, so that the two fall into Ugin's memories by touching hands inside the hedron.
When the dragon Bolas twists Naiva's mind and she holds a knife to Baishya's throat, Naiva snaps out of it, and Baishya later wears Naiva's mantle to face Bolas beside Yasova.

Yasova tells Bolas that the Immortal Sun will trap him and Baishya says they hear the artifact, so Bolas, fearing the bluff may be true, strikes the canyon and flees, and Baishya's earth magic has shielded her and Yasova.
